# SPP Framework (Satya Portal Platform)
> A high-performance, event-driven, modular PHP enterprise framework designed for zero-inline-HTML, declarative YAML workflows, active record entities, reactive view components, and Parikshak automated testing.

## Golden Rules for AI Agents (Never Violate)
1. **Zero Inline HTML**: NEVER write inline HTML literals inside PHP controllers, services, or JavaScript. ALL markup MUST live in standalone external Blade/Twig templates or partials (`resources/views/partials/`).
2. **Native Entities & Database Modernization**: All database models MUST extend `\SPPMod\SPPDB\SPPEntity`. NEVER use raw PDO or disconnected SQL. Leverages:
   - Request-scoped in-memory Identity Map (`\SPPMod\SPPDB\IdentityMap`) for single object references and zero redundant queries.
   - First-class chainable relation objects (`\SPPMod\SPPDB\Relations\Relation`: `hasMany`, `belongsTo`, `hasOne`, `morphMany`).
   - Nested transaction savepoints (`SPPDB::createSavepoint`, `releaseSavepoint`, `rollbackToSavepoint`).
   - PHP 8.2+ declarative attributes (`#[Table]`, `#[Id]`, `#[Column]`, `#[HasMany]`, `#[Workflow]`).
   - Zero-downtime shadow-table migrations (`\SPPMod\SPPDB\Migration\SafeDDLRunner`).
   - Dialect-native AI vector similarity search (`SppEntityQuery::whereSemanticSimilarity()`).
   - Strongly-typed IDE helper generation (`php spp.php make:entity-types`).
3. **Declarative Workflows**: NEVER mutate `$entity->status = '...'` as a string. Lifecycle states are defined in YAML (`etc/apps/<AppName>/workflows/`) and transitioned via `$entity->applyTransition()` or `$this->transitionEntity()`.
4. **Parikshak Testing**: Parikshak is the official test engine (`\SPPMod\Parikshak\SPPTestCase`). Tests run via `php spp.php test [--coverage]`.
5. **Strict CLI SAPI Guarding**: High-privilege CLI commands MUST implement `public function isCLIOnly(): bool { return true; }`.
6. **Unified Resilient Event Bus & Oracle Triggers**: Dispatch occurrences via `\SPP\SPPEvent::fireEvent()` or `\SPP\SPPEvent::triggerHook()` (unified with dot/colon normalization, listener error isolation, and deduplication). Use `:OLD`/`:NEW` pseudorecords on `EventParams`, `->when()` conditional triggers, `CompoundTrigger`, `abort()`, `autonomous()`, and `afterCommit()` for transactional integrity.
7. **Local Assets Only**: NEVER link external CDNs (unpkg, jsdelivr). Use local distributions via `/sppadmin/js/htmx.min.js`.
8. **Dual Man Pages**: Every CLI command MUST have dual documentation: Markdown (`docs/commands/<cmd>.md`) AND Unix troff (`docs/commands/man/<cmd>.1`).
9. **Developer Simplicity & Anti-Complexity**: Keep SPP simple for developers. Eliminate boilerplate. Never introduce complex multi-layer abstractions or gratuitous features unless justified by extraordinary, undeniable value. Advanced features must be 100% opt-in and zero-overhead.
10. **Unified Chunked Routing & Type-Safe Reverse Generation**: Define routes in **one place only** (`src/<AppName>/etc/routes.yml`, PHP 8 `#[Route]` attributes, or fluent `Router::get()`). Leverages:
   - $O(1)$ static route hash map lookup (< 0.02ms) and PCRE `(*MARK:mX)` chunked combined regex evaluation (< 0.15ms) via `CompiledRouter`.
   - First-class type-safe reverse routing (`route('name', $params, $absolute)`) with automatic `SPPEntity` unwrapping and query string handling.
   - Declarative parameter constraints (`#[WhereNumber('id')]`, `#[WhereUuid('token')]`, `#[WhereAlpha]`, `#[WhereAlphaNumeric]`, `#[Where]`).
   - Native template directives: `@route('name', ...)` in Blade and `route('name', ...)` in Twig.
   - Client-side reverse routing and predictive hover prefetching via `spp-router.js` and `var/cache/routes.json`.
   - Modular `RouteServiceProviderInterface` and `RouteDispatcher` protocol decoupling (SCIM, OAuth, Asset, AutoApi) from `public/index.php`.
11. **Framework Sovereignty & Implementation Purity**: External software names are permitted in planning documents strictly for comparative benchmarking, but strictly PROHIBITED in actual implementation (code, UI, labels, comments, and production docs). Adapt all features natively as sovereign first-class SPP capabilities.
12. **Modular Navigation & Plug-and-Play Packages**: Navigation links for Ctrl+K, 9-dot App Launcher, and Sidebar MUST NEVER be hardcoded in view templates. Autonomous packages declare navigation in `menus.yml`. `MenuRegistry` dynamically aggregates and filters links based on `PackageKernel::hasPackage()` and `FeatureManager::isEnabled()`. Inactive packages and disabled features remain strictly invisible.
13. **Modularity 2.0 & Declarative Module Schemas**: All modules define configuration and metadata strictly via YAML (`module.yml`), declarative schemas via `db.yml`, zero-boot events via `events.yml`, and container wiring via `\SPP\Core\Interfaces\ServiceProviderInterface`. Module configurations are managed via `\SPP\Core\ModuleConfigManager`. Kernel compulsory modules (`Module::isCompulsory()`) cannot be disabled or uninstalled.
14. **Dual-Personality Multi-Tenant Architecture & User-Home sppdata**: SPP operates in two architectural personalities: **Single Domain Mode** (`mode: single`, zero domain configuration, copy-paste ready for any host/IP without domain routing required or enforced) and **Sovereign Multi-Domain Cloud Manager** (`mode: multi`, virtual host multiplexing active and enforced via `etc/domains.yml`). In multi-domain mode:
   - **User Home Isolation**: Applications (`/home/<user>/apps/<app>`) and persistent data (`/home/<user>/sppdata/<domain>/<app>`) reside in user home directories, preserving Linux permissions, disk quotas, and backup boundaries.
   - **Universal Root App (`/`) Selection**: Any domain can designate either an SPP application OR an external non-SPP application (Drupal, WordPress, Laravel, or static HTML) as its root homepage.
   - **Sub-Route Coexistence & Subdirectory Virtualization**: Domains can host multiple apps on arbitrary sub-routes (e.g. `/` = SPPDocs, `/home` = Drupal, `/portal` = SPP app). External apps run with full environment virtualization (`SCRIPT_NAME = /home/index.php`, `CONTEXT_PREFIX = /home`, `DOCUMENT_ROOT`, Drupal clean URLs `$_GET['q']`, and direct static asset streaming).
   - **Data Autonomy & SPPClient**: Non-SPP apps retain 100% database autonomy, but can opt-in to store/read shared data in `sppdata/` via the standalone `SPPClient` (`spp-client.php`) and headless JSON-RPC (`public/spp-api.php`).
   - **Full SPPAdmin GUI Management**: All domains, accounts, paths, root apps, and sub-routes are manageable via `/sppadmin/#domains` with 1-click directory probing. Configure modes via `php spp.php domain:mode [single|multi]`.
15. **Universal OS, Infrastructure & File Services Engine**: NEVER use raw `file_put_contents()`, `unlink()`, `mkdir()`, or `file_get_contents()` for configuration, staging, or high-concurrency file manipulation. ALWAYS leverage `\SPP\Infra` (`\SPP\Core\Infra`), `\SPP\File` (`\SPP\Core\File`), and `\SPP\Storage` (`\SPP\Core\Storage`). Guarantees cross-OS execution across Windows, Linux (Debian, RHEL, Alpine musl, Arch, SUSE), macOS, BSD, WSL, Docker, Kubernetes, and Serverless (AWS Lambda, Cloud Run). Features atomic staging writes (`File::putAtomic()`, `Storage::writeYaml()`), pure-PHP cloud S3/R2/MinIO storage (`S3Disk`), virtual in-memory storage (`MemoryDisk`), generator-backed directory query builder (`File::find()`), 4-tier MIME detection, expiring signed URLs (`temporaryUrl`), and HTTP 206 partial content streaming (`Storage::streamDownload()`).
16. **Universal Polyglot 2.0 & Cross-Language DSL Engine**: SPP natively supports executing 47+ programming languages (Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, Zig, Ruby, Elixir, Lua, Java, C#, Swift, Kotlin, TypeScript, Dart, Haskell, Clojure, Scala, PHP, Julia, R, WASM, Solidity, Shell, etc.) and custom developer-scripted Domain-Specific Languages (DSLs). All languages are defined declaratively via YAML drivers (`etc/polyglot/*.yml` or `etc/apps/<App>/polyglot/*.yml`). Features dynamic zero-restart activation toggles (`php spp.php polyglot:toggle <lang> [--enable|--disable]`), persistence in `etc/polyglot/status.yml`, and an interactive Web GUI in SPPAdmin & SPPDev (`#polyglot`). The engine features an OS-agnostic multi-tier IPC cascade (In-Process AST evaluation -> POSIX Unix Domain Sockets / Windows Named Pipes -> Fast TCP loopback -> Length-prefixed stdin/stdout framing), dynamic on-the-fly compilation caching in `var/cache/polyglot/bin/`, cross-platform binary discovery across Windows, Linux, macOS, and BSD via `Platform`, zero-inline-HTML view partial rendering via `$this->renderPolyglotPartial()`, and template macros `@polyglot('service.ext', $data)`. Scaffold new drivers or custom DSL evaluators via `php spp.php make:polyglot-language <name> [--ext=<ext>] [--category=...]`.
17. **SPPAdmin & SPPDev Visual Operations & App Studio Console**: SPP provides companion browser workstations (SPPAdmin at `/sppadmin` for production operations and SPPDev at `/sppdev` for development) powered by `CommandBridge.php`. Features a Novice-First decluttered UI with progressive disclosure (`spp-page-guide`, collapsible `spp-advanced-accordion` drawers), dynamic interactive help popovers (`.spp-help-tip`), and a built-in Jargon Buster Glossary (`Ctrl+H`, `openJargonBuster()`). Includes a 1-click Domain Architecture Mode switcher (Single Domain zero-config vs Multi-Domain virtual host multi-tenancy), Universal Infrastructure & OS Topology inspector (`\SPP\Infra` metrics, web server adapters, hosting topology), App Studio domain scoping (`Global` vs `Domain-Only`), and complete application decommissioning management (`\SPP\Core\AppUninstaller`): config-only removal, full code purge, automated safety backup archives (`var/backups/apps/`), 1-click restoration, and permanent backup deletion to reclaim server disk space.
18. **Sovereign User Governance, Store Architecture & Moderation Queue**: Multi-creator package distribution and project administration are decoupled into a dedicated Publisher Dashboard (`/store/dashboard`), Self-Service Project Creation Wizard (`/store/project/create`), and central Store registry (`/store`). User identities and bcrypt hashes are unified via `UserService` and `PermissionManager` (`src/SPPDocs/data/users.json`). Projects support 4 content paradigms (`app`, `module`, `docs`, `presentation`) and 4 granular visibility levels: `public`, `personal`, `closed_group`, and `team`. Package-to-Project auto-linking dynamically renders 1-click CLI installation badges (`php spp.php pkg:install <package>`) and bidirectional showcase routing. Projects can be archived (`is_archived: true`, `status: archived`), isolating them from primary showcase listings. Global Admins hold sovereign moderation authority via the centralized Content Moderation Queue (`/admin/moderation`): suspending/banning malicious accounts, featuring verified projects (`is_featured: true`), or suspending policy-violating content.
19. **Native Multi-Model XML Database (SPPXDB) & The 4 Apex Pillars**: SPPXDB (`SPPMod\SPPXDB\SPP_XDB`) is a high-performance native multi-model database engine combining:
   - **Zero-Copy Flat Buffer (`.xbam`, `XbamEngine`)**: 32-byte fixed binary node structs with Dietz Pre/Post interval containment ($O(1)$ structural axes) and segregated string/value pools.
   - **MarkLogic-Style Universal Inverted Index (`UniversalIndex`)**: Unified inverted postings for paths, values, word tokens, and range scalars with composite intersection.
   - **Native AI RAG Subsystem (`RagEngine`, `SemanticChunker`)**: Tree-aware XML chunking with ancestor breadcrumb preservation, hybrid Vector+BM25 search, and AI function-calling tool schemas.
   - **Bi-Temporal Time Travel (`BiTemporalEngine`)**: SQL:2011 / XTDB dual-timeline (Valid Time vs System Time) with point-in-time 'As-Of' queries and non-destructive corrections.
   - **Cryptographic Merkle DAG Ledger (`MerkleLedger`)**: SHA-256 hash chains, rolling roots, inclusion proofs, and zero-trust mathematical disk tamper detection.
   - **Reactive Live Queries & Turbo Streams (`LiveQueryManager`)**: Standing query subscriptions generating real-time Hotwire Turbo Streams (`<turbo-stream>`) and SSE.
   - **Advanced ANSI SQL Dialect**: Common Table Expressions (`WITH`), $O(N+M)$ Hash Joins, Outer Joins, Correlated `EXISTS`, `UPSERT`, Transaction Savepoints, SQL/JSON and SQL/XML duality functions, and ANSI Window Functions (`ROW_NUMBER`, `RANK`, `DENSE_RANK`, `SUM OVER`, `LAG`, `LEAD`).
   - **CLI Tooling**: `php spp.php xdb:query <sql|xpath|xquery|xquf>`, `php spp.php xdb:stats`, `php spp.php xdb:index:rebuild`, `php spp.php xdb:benchmark`.
20. **Root Privilege Separation & SPP Server Agent Control Plane**: PHP MUST NEVER BECOME THE ROOT-LEVEL CONTROL PLANE. The PHP web application (`spp/admin/`) runs as an unprivileged OS user (`www-data` or `sppadmin`) without direct sudo or unrestricted shell execution (`execute_shell_command`). All privileged host operations are delegated to the standalone **SPP Server Agent** daemon (`spp/agent/`) over a restricted Unix domain socket (`/var/run/spp/agent.sock`, mode `0660`, `root:sppadmin`) with `SO_PEERCRED` peer credential verification:
   - **Zero Shell String Interpolation**: Safe process execution via `ProcessExecutor` using `proc_open()` with structured argument arrays, `bypass_shell => true`, null-byte (`\0`) and control character rejection, process tree termination, and 30s timeouts.
   - **56 Typed Registered Operations**: Spanning 10 functional domains (System, Services, Storage, Networking, Firewall, Packages, Users/SSH, Webserver, PHP, Database) with strict parameter schemas, types, and regex validation.
   - **Operation Engine Lifecycle**: Complete 11-stage pipeline: Authenticate -> Authorize -> Validate -> Capabilities -> Preflight -> Plan -> Diff Preview -> Confirmation Gating -> Agent Execute -> Post-Execution Verify -> Audit -> Automatic Compensating Rollback.
   - **Fail-Closed RBAC & Secrets Management**: Any unmapped action strictly returns `false` (`gateAdminAction() === false`). Secrets (API keys, certificates, passwords) are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM via `SecretsService` using a master key isolated outside webroot (`/var/run/spp/master.key`, mode `0600`). API keys are stored as SHA-256 hashes and displayed masked (`spp_...abcd`).
   - **Native Testing Engine (Parikshak)**: Automated verification runs deterministically via `\SPPMod\Parikshak\SPPTestCase` using in-memory mock drivers (`MockDriver`) and in-process server dispatch (`Client::setInProcessServer($server)`). Zero failures tolerated.

## Directory Taxonomy
- `spp/`: Framework core (App kernel, autoloader, event dispatcher, CLI, modules).
- `src/<AppName>/`: Domain application code:
  - `Controllers/`: ViewControllers, ResourceControllers.
  - `Models/`: Database models extending `SPPEntity`.
  - `LiveComponents/`: Reactive UI components.
  - `resources/views/`: External Blade/Twig templates and partials.
  - `tests/`: Parikshak test suites extending `SPPTestCase`.
- `etc/polyglot/`: Declarative YAML language driver specifications for Universal Polyglot 2.0.
- `etc/apps/<AppName>/workflows/`: Declarative YAML workflow state machines.
- `etc/apps/<AppName>/pages/`: SPP Studio visual page manifests (YAML).
- `docs/`: Framework documentation, tutorials, and dual-format man pages.
- `domains/<domain>/src/<AppName>/`: Domain-isolated application code strictly accessible only on the installed host.
- `domains/_vhosts/`: Apache and Nginx web server virtual host configuration templates.

## Core CLI Commands
- `php spp.php domain:mode [single|multi|policy] [--subdomain-policy=...] [--json]`: Inspect or toggle domain architecture mode (Single Domain zero-config vs Multi-Domain virtual host multi-tenancy) and virtual host policy modes (`strict`, `inherit`, `redirect`, `dynamic_tenant`, `permissive`).
- `php spp.php domain:app:install <domain> <appName> [--make-default] [--title="..."] [--allow-others]`: Install and scaffold an application strictly isolated to a domain in `domains/<domain>/src/<app>`.
- `php spp.php domain:app:scope <appName> [--domain-only] [--allow=domain1,domain2] [--global]`: Inspect and configure domain-only accessibility whitelist or reopen globally for any application.
- `php spp.php domain:server:configure [--mode=setup|export|import] [--domain=...] [--bundle=...] [--remap=old:new]`: Server provisioning, Apache/Nginx vhost generation, and cross-server bundle migration.
- `php spp.php host:installer [--domain=...] [--app=...] [--php=8.3] [--webserver=nginx] [--ssl] [--save] [--one-liner] [--preview]`: Generate, preview, and provision sovereign bare-metal VPS host installer scripts (`spp-host-installer.sh`, `install.sh`), production Nginx virtual host, and systemd service daemons (`spp-worker.service`, `spp-watchdog.service`) for zero-cPanel deployments.
- `install.sh` & `curl -sSL https://<domain>/install.sh | sudo bash -s --`: 1-line automated remote server bootstrap for clean Ubuntu 24.04/22.04 LTS, Debian 12/11, and AlmaLinux 9/RHEL 9 nodes (0 MB idle overhead, zero commercial control panel dependencies).
- `install.php` & `php spp/bin/spp-domain-installer.php <audit|install|uninstall|restore|backups|scope|configure|export|import>`: Standalone universal server prerequisite auditor, domain application installer, uninstaller, backup manager, and Web GUI onboarding gateway.
- `php spp.php app:uninstall <AppName> [--config-only | --full] [--backup] [--keep-db] [--force] [--dry-run]`: Decommission applications (Config-Only mode preserves `src/`, Full mode purges code & configs; `--backup` generates pre-removal archive in `var/backups/apps/`).
- `php spp.php app:restore <backup_file_or_appName> [--force]`: Reconstruct application code, configs, SQLite database, and domain bindings from a backup archive.
- `php spp.php app:backup [<appName>] [--list] [--delete=<file>] [--purge=<appName>]`: Manage standalone backup archives, inspect disk usage, and delete archives to reclaim server disk space.
- `php spp.php app:bundle [--apps=<app1,app2|all>] [--out=<path>] [--format=zip|tar.gz|dir] [--with-db] [--verify=<file>] [--diff[=<target>]] [--push[=<target>]] [--key=<token>]`: Package applications and framework into an autonomous deployment bundle, or differentially push local code updates directly to target servers via integrated SPPDeploy.
- `php spp.php app:start [<app_id>|all]`: Boot multi-language application daemons (Node.js, Python FastAPI/Flask, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP-FPM) under the sovereign cross-platform SPP supervisor.
- `php spp.php app:stop [<app_id>|all]`: Gracefully terminate running application daemons.
- `php spp.php app:restart <app_id>`: Restart application daemons and reload runtime configuration.
- `php spp.php app:status [--json]`: Live operational dashboard displaying PIDs, allocated ports, route prefixes, and runtime states across Windows, Linux, and macOS.
- `php spp.php app:logs <app_id> [--tail=50]`: Inspect or stream real-time stdout and stderr log outputs for an application daemon.
- `php spp.php mesh:call <app_id> <endpoint> [json_payload] [--method=POST]`: Dispatch inter-app RPC requests to guest microservices or peer applications across the SPP service mesh.
- `php spp.php mesh:services [--json]`: Discover and list all capabilities declared under `spp_integration.expose_services` in `etc/apps.yml`.
- **Developer Studio Workbench (`/sppdev#apps`, `/sppdev#mesh`)**: Unified single-pane-of-glass dashboard integrating native SPP applications and multi-language guest microservices (Python, Node.js, Go, PHP-FPM, Static SPA) with real-time supervisor controls, live log streaming, interactive RPC sandbox, and inter-app event bus inspector.
- `php spp.php server:configure [--domain=<domain>] [--app=<appName>] [--db-driver=<driver>] [--map=...] [--interactive]`: Provision domains, databases, and web server virtual hosts (Apache/Nginx/Caddy) on a target server.
- `php spp.php route:list [--app=AppName] [--method=GET|POST] [--compile]`: Discover, aggregate, and compile application routes.
- `php spp.php route:export [--app=AppName] [--format=json|yaml]`: Export aggregated routes to standard OpenAPI 3.1 specifications.
- `php spp.php test:impact [--since=git_ref] [--dry-run]`: Selectively execute impacted Parikshak tests using convention matching and manifests.
- `php spp.php arch:lint [path] [--app=AppName] [--strict]`: Statically audit clean architecture layers and domain boundary isolation.
- `php spp.php flag:list` & `php spp.php flag:toggle <name>`: Inspect and live-toggle declarative feature flags and canary rollouts.
- `php spp.php ai:context [prompt] [--app=AppName] [--max-tokens=N]`: Synthesize zero-shot framework architectural specifications and Knowledge Graph RAG.
- `php spp.php blueprint:run <file.yml> [--seed=N]`: Provision complete applications from single-file declarative blueprints with automated schema sync and smart seeding.
- `php spp.php blueprint:ai "<prompt>" [--run] [--seed=N]`: Synthesize declarative application YAML blueprints from natural language prompts.
- `php spp.php db:seed <Entity> [--count=10]`: Populate database tables with schema-derived realistic synthetic domain data and workflow states.
- `php spp.php make:seeder <SeederName> [--app=AppName]`: Scaffold a modern fluent database seeder class extending `\SPPMod\SPPDB\SPPSeeder`.
- `php spp.php sys:seed [app_name]`: Discover and execute all database seeders with captured log audit trail.
- php spp.php make:app <AppName>: Scaffold a complete new application.
- php spp.php make:module <name> [--scope=app|optional|contrib|spp] [--app=AppName]: Scaffold a complete module skeleton with module.yml, db.yml, lifecycle scripts, and ServiceProvider.
- php spp.php module:list [--app=AppName] [--filter=keyword] [--status=active|inactive] [--json]: Discover and tabulate kernel, optional, contrib, and application modules.
- php spp.php module:update <modulename>|--all: Synchronize db.yml database schemas and trigger lifecycle update hooks.
- php spp.php module:doctor [modulename] [--fix] [--json]: Audit module health, dependency constraints, and database schema drift against db.yml.
- php spp.php test:module <modulename> [--filter=...] [--compact] [--profile] [--bail]: Run native Parikshak automated test suites for an isolated module.
- php spp.php module:pack <modulename> [--out=dist] [--format=zip|tar.gz]: Validate and package a module into a clean, distributable archive.
- php spp.php module:setting:list <modulename>: Inspect and tabulate module settings, types, effective values, and defaults.
- php spp.php module:setting:update <modulename> <key> <val>: Validate and persist a module configuration setting.
- php spp.php make:scaffold <Entity> [--app=AppName]: Scaffold Model, Controller, Views, Migration.
- php spp.php make:entity-types [--app=AppName] [--out=path]: Generate strongly-typed IDE helper stubs (_ide_entity_helper.php) with @property annotations, relation return types, and query builders.
- php spp.php make:form <Name> [--app=AppName] [--yaml] [--php] [--entity=Entity] [--fields="name:type:rules,..."]: Scaffold a zero-code declarative YAML form definition (etc/apps/<app>/forms/<name>.yml, default) or fluent PHP builder class with specialized controls (signatures, OTP, tags, repeaters, honeypot), select options bracket notation (`select[a|b]`), 1-click schema synthesis from SPPEntity models or SQL tables (--entity=User), custom validators (`pan`, `aadhaar`), database validators (`unique:table,column`, `exists:table,column`), reactive dependencies (dependsOn, computed), and workflow actions.
- php spp.php make:rule <Name> [--app=AppName] [--pattern=regex] [--min=N] [--max=N]: Scaffold a universal custom validator Rule class (src/<AppName>/Rules/<Name>Rule.php) extending Rule and auto-register its alias in etc/apps/<AppName>/validators.yml with 4-way validation synchronization (PHP, HTML5, SPP-UX, LiveComponents).
- sppdev Form & Validation Studio (/sppdev) & Drishyam Studio (#pages): Web developer workbench featuring visual drag-and-drop form designer with regional IDs (pan, aadhaar, gstin, ifsc, pincode), 1-click `⚡ From Entity` model-to-form synthesis, Tab 4 validation inspector with live app-rules discovery, Drishyam Studio 📝 Forms palette (1-click form insert, plain HTML form schema binding via `@sppform_bind('id', $entity)` with automatic initial entity hydration & old-input preservation, 1-click `🧪 Test` Live Form Sandbox with live payload inspection and server validation execution, WYSIWYG rule attachment), real-time 400ms debounced remote validation (`unique`, `exists`, `live_validate_field`), modern Blade directives (`@error('field')`, `@old('field', $default)`), Custom Validators & Rule Studio suite with live regex tester, visual rule scaffolding, and 1-click Code Studio deep-linking (#coder?file=...), plus zero-param controller validation via `$this->validateForm()`, `$this->validateFormOrFail()`, ergonomic `$this->backWithErrors($validation)`, mass-assignment safe `$validation->validated()`, `$validation->only()`, `$validation->except()`, and magic property access (`$validation->field_name`).
- php spp.php make:report <Name> [--app=AppName]: Scaffold an enterprise declarative SPPReport YAML configuration and external presentation partial with executive KPI cards (@sppreport_kpi) and interactive toolbar.
- php spp.php make:partial <Name.blade.php> [--app=AppName]: Generate an external reactive partial.
- php spp.php make:page <PageName> [--app=AppName] [--template=dashboard|crud|detail|form|blank]: Scaffold an SPP Studio visual page manifest.
- `php spp.php compile:page <PageName> [--app=AppName] [--all]`: Compile page manifests into ViewController + Blade + Parikshak tests.
- `php spp.php test [--coverage]`: Execute Parikshak automated test runner.
- `php spp.php ai:recipes [feature]`: Output verified, copy-pasteable architectural recipes.
- `php spp.php event:list-listeners [--app=AppName]`: Discover, aggregate, and inspect all registered event listeners and priority ordering.
- `php spp.php event:fire --event=<name> [--payload=<json>]`: Manually dispatch and test event listeners from the CLI.
- `php spp.php ai:lint <file>`: Validate code against the 10 Golden Invariants.
- `php spp.php props:compile [--app=AppName]`: Compile workspace manifests into $O(1)$ OPcache array cache and binary SQLite WAL ledger in under 1 second.
- `php spp.php props:sbom [--format=cyclonedx|spdx] [--out=file.json]`: Generate official CycloneDX 1.5 or SPDX 2.3 Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) with cryptographic signatures.
- `php spp.php props:heal [path] [--app=AppName] [--dry-run]`: Continuous self-healing AST synchronizer reconciling interfaces, model layers, and template required props.
- `php spp.php props:search "<query>" [--semantic] [--limit=N]`: Hybrid semantic vector and token search across codebase manifests.
- `php spp.php props:impact <path>`: Calculate semantic blast radius and risk score.
- `php spp.php props:contracts [--verify-db]`: Audit declarative error fallbacks, pre-flight database schema contracts, and SSR streaming policies.
- `php spp.php evaarta:account [--list|--presets|--add|--test|--sync|--default|--delete]`: Manage multi-provider email accounts with autodiscovery and testing.
- `php spp.php mail:account [list|create|passwd|quota|suspend|unsuspend|delete|forwarder:add|forwarder:list|forwarder:del]`: Sovereign local server virtual mailbox hosting, password reset, Maildir scaffolding, quota allocation, and forwarders.
- `php spp.php evaarta:process-snooze [--daemon] [--interval=N]`: Wake expired snoozed threads into e-Vaarta primary inbox.
- `php spp.php evaarta:root [--status|--enable|--disable] [--domain=host]`: Serve e-Vaarta at server root (`/`) or dedicated virtual host.
- `php spp.php evaarta:listen [--port=2525]`: Pure-PHP RFC 5321 inbound SMTP socket server.
- `php spp.php shield:audit [--json]`: Automated 25-point security compliance and hardening audit.
- `php spp.php shield:firewall [--block=IP] [--unblock=IP] [--whitelist=IP]`: Multi-tier packet filter and IP ban management.
- `php spp.php shield:scan [path] [--quarantine]`: Heuristic malware, webshell, and code injection detector.
- `php spp.php metrics:status [--json]`: Live hardware telemetry HUD (CPU, RAM, Disk, PHP runtime).
- `php spp.php metrics:traffic [--log=path] [--limit=N] [--json]`: Web access log parser and visitor traffic analyzer.
- `php spp.php server:service [list|status|start|stop|restart]`: Cross-platform host service manager (`systemctl` / `sc.exe`).
- `php spp.php server:process [list|kill|renice]`: Live process workstation with CPU/RAM metrics and PID signals.
- `php spp.php import:cpanel <archive> [--domain=...] [--dry-run] [--skip-db] [--skip-mail] [--skip-dns]`: High-performance 1-click cPanel/WHM backup importer (.tar.gz, .zip, .tar) restoring docroot, SQLite DB, virtual mailboxes, forwarders, and BIND DNS zones.
- `php spp.php server:account [create|get|suspend|unsuspend|list]`: Multi-tenant hosting account provisioning with lifecycle workflows.
- `php spp.php server:migrate [inspect|restore]`: Standard `cpmove-*.tar.gz` backup archive inspector, extractor, and database restorer.
- `php spp.php apps:install <app> [--docroot=...]`: 1-Click CMS & framework scaffolder (WordPress, Laravel, Drupal).
- `php spp.php apps:wp [inspect|harden|cli]`: WordPress security hardening, table prefix auditing, and WP-CLI bridge.
- `php spp.php apps:staging [create|push]`: Staging clone isolator and atomic production push with pre-push safety snapshots.
- `php spp.php runtime:php [list|switch]`: Multi-PHP version auto-detection and per-docroot FastCGI proxy switcher.
- `php spp.php runtime:fpm [list|create|delete|test]`: PHP-FPM worker pool manager and live socket/TCP connectivity diagnostics.
- `php spp.php runtime:ini [get|set|override]`: Visual PHP.INI directive editor, backups, and per-docroot `.user.ini` overrides.
- `php spp.php reseller:account [list|create|suspend|unsuspend|delete]`: Sovereign multi-tenant reseller provisioning with lifecycle workflow.
- `php spp.php reseller:limits <username> [--quota=MB] [--oversell=1|0]`: Pooled quota and overselling capacity risk auditor.
- `php spp.php reseller:features [list|get|save]`: Modular hosting feature profiles and access restrictions.
- `php spp.php reseller:brand <username> [--title=...] [--color=#hex]`: Custom white-label branding, portal titles, and CSS accents.
- `php spp.php server:ftp [list|create|delete|quota]`: Virtual FTP tenant accounts and directory isolation.
- `php spp.php server:git [status|pull|log]`: Git version control workstation for tenant docroots.
- `php spp.php ai:sre [diagnose|summarize|copilot|patch]`: Sovereign Site Reliability Engineering, error diagnosis, git blame, log summary, and Copilot command plan execution.
- `php spp.php deploy:canary [deploy|rollback|status] [--app=...]`: Atomic Blue/Green zero-downtime deployment and canary rollback engine (<1ms symlink switch).
- `php spp.php shield:ast-scan [path] [--quarantine]`: Token-level AST PHP malware, webshell, and backdoor scanner.
- `php spp.php db:advisor [list|explain|apply-index] [--db=...]`: Visual slow query advisor, EXPLAIN query plan analysis, and non-destructive index optimization.
- `php spp.php deploy:mixed [action] [--app=...] [--strategy=mixed|delta|artifact|canary] [--canary=weight]`: Unified mixed strategy deployment orchestrator fusing Git/sovereign lineage, preflight Parikshak quality gates, AST shield scanning, delta syncing, and atomic Blue/Green canary rotations (<1ms switch).
- `php spp.php app:bundle [--apps=...] [--out=...] [--diff=target] [--push=target]`: Autonomous application packager creating standalone deployment bundles with integrated differential SPPDeploy synchronization.
- `php spp.php server:configure [--domain=...] [--app=...] [--db=...] [--audit]`: Target server onboarding wizard, domain routing, DB verification, and vhost synthesis (Apache/Nginx/Caddy).
- `php spp.php deploy:secrets [init|set|get|list|delete|decrypt|sync]`: Zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM envelope encryption for environment secrets (`.sppsecrets.enc`).
- `php spp.php deploy:impact [--target=...] [--app=...] [--enforce] [--dry-run]`: Pre-flight change blast radius calculator and Parikshak test gating engine.
- `php spp.php deploy:sentinel [split|status|watch|promote|abort]`: Autonomous canary traffic splitting, SLA threshold evaluation, and circuit breaker rollback.
- `php spp.php deploy:telemetry [--target=...] [--app=...] [--watch]`: Real-time production observability console tracking host memory, releases, slow queries, and crash traces.
- `php spp.php deploy:sre:heal [--target=...] [--auto-patch] [--dry-run]`: Closed-loop AI-SRE auto-remediation, stack trace parsing, AST patch synthesis, and Parikshak regression test generation.
- `php spp.php pkg:pack <app|module> <name> [--version=...] [--scope=system|app] [--app=...]`: Package a standalone application or module into a `.spppkg` archive with `package.yml` and SHA-256 integrity.
- `php spp.php pkg:publish <file> [--repo=satyalab] [--token=...] [--url=...]`: Publish a package archive or external asset link to the central repository.
- `php spp.php pkg:search [query] [--type=all|app|module]`: Search central registry catalog (satyalab.net) for applications and modules.
- `php spp.php pkg:info <name> [--version=...]`: Inspect package metadata, dependencies, license, and download endpoints.
- `php spp.php pkg:install <source> [--as=...] [--scope=system|app] [--app=...]`: Universal installer resolving central registry, direct URLs, GitHub releases, or local files.
- `php spp.php pkg:update [name] [--check] [--all]`: Check for updates and upgrade installed applications and modules.
- `php spp.php pkg:repo [list|add|remove|test]`: Manage configured repository endpoints in `etc/pkg-repositories.yml`.
- `php spp.php repo:build [--dir=...] [--url=...]`: Compile package archives into an authoritative `packages.json` catalog and static HTML browsing interface.
- `php spp.php fleet:node [list|add|remove|ping|broadcast|sync-dns]`: Multi-server fleet orchestrator, distributed compute telemetry, command broadcasting, and authoritative BIND DNS cluster replication.
- `php spp.php webhook:listen [list|create|listen|replay|clear|delete]`: Sovereign inbound webhook relay, tunnel, HMAC signature verification (Stripe, GitHub, Shopify, Razorpay), and 1-click local replay.
- `php spp.php quickstart <AppName>`: Zero-ceremony novice application generator provisioning clean MVC structure, Active Record entity, declarative YAML workflow, external Blade templates, partials, Parikshak tests, and automatic registration in `global-settings.yml`.
- `php spp.php test [path] [--coverage] [--filter=...]`: Execute native Parikshak automated test suites under isolated in-memory SQLite, targeted test files, or filter by pattern.
- `php spp.php workflow:simulate <workflow_key> [--transition=...] [--state=...] [--saga-rollback] [--timeout-escalate]`: Interactive state machine stepping, validation guard evaluation, SLA timeout escalations, and Saga compensating rollbacks.
- `php spp.php workflow:dump <name> [--format=mermaid|dot] [--file=...]`: Export visual workflow state machine diagrams (Mermaid.js or Graphviz DOT) with associative states and guard annotations.
- `php spp.php workflow:process-timeouts [--dry-run]`: Process expired SLA timeout deadlines on entities and automatically trigger configured escalation transitions.
- `php spp.php cqrs:webhooks:dispatch [--batch=N]`: Daemon processing transactional outbox webhooks from `spp_cqrs_outbox` with HMAC-SHA256 signatures (`X-SPP-Signature`) and exponential backoff retries.
- `php spp.php make:polyglot-language <name> [--ext=<ext>] [--category=interpreted|compiled|dsl|wasm] [--app=AppName]`: Provision a declarative YAML language driver or custom in-process DSL grammar evaluator class.
- `php spp.php polyglot:status`: Inspect and audit host runtime environments, discovering installed compilers, interpreters, paths, and versions across all registered languages.
- `php spp.php polyglot:list`: Recursively discover and tabulate all polyglot scripts, compiled services, and DSL files across the workspace.
- `php spp.php polyglot:eval "<code>" [--lang=formula|python|node|...] [--context='{...}']`: Instant on-the-fly execution and benchmarking of code expressions and snippets.
- `php spp.php polyglot:repl [language]`: Interactive terminal Read-Eval-Print-Loop (REPL) shell for rapid prototyping with persistent context.
- `php spp.php polyglot:test <path> [--payload='{...}'] [--daemon]`: Test-run and benchmark any polyglot service, capturing execution latency and memory.
- `php spp.php polyglot:status [--json]`: Scans and tabulates binary paths, version info, and activation state (ENABLED/DISABLED) for all 47+ registered language drivers across the current OS.
- `php spp.php polyglot:toggle <language> [--enable|--disable] [--json]`: Dynamically activates or deactivates language execution permissions on the fly without web server restarts.
- `php spp.php polyglot:eval "<code>" [--lang=formula|python|node|...] [--context='{...}']`: Evaluates an ad-hoc code snippet or mathematical expression on the fly with microsecond telemetry.
- `php spp.php polyglot:repl [language]`: Launches an interactive Read-Eval-Print-Loop terminal shell.
- `php spp.php polyglot:test <path> [--payload='{...}']`: Benchmarks execution duration and memory consumption for any polyglot service fragment.
- `php spp.php make:polyglot-partial <name.ext> [--lang=<lang>] [--app=AppName]`: Scaffold a new external polyglot view partial service file for any registered language.

## Core Framework Primitives
- `$entity->rollback($user, $comment, $context)`: Native fluent Saga compensating rollback that unwinds entity states along recorded `spp_entity_workflow_history` lineage.
- `\SPPMod\SPPWorkflow\WorkflowManager::get($name)`: Universal workflow definition lookup with automatic suffix resolution (`article` <-> `article_workflow`) and schema normalization.
- `\SPP\Polyglot`: Unified developer-friendly facade for polyglot execution (`Polyglot::run()`, `eval()`, `python()`, `node()`, `formula()`, `file()->fallback()->get()`).
- `\SPP\Core\Polyglot\LanguageRegistry`: Universal catalog for 47+ languages with dynamic extension resolution, activation state (`isEnabled()`, `enable()`, `disable()`, `toggle()`), custom DSL registration, and OS binary discovery.
- `\SPP\Admin\Services\PolyglotAdminService`: Dedicated backend service powering SPPAdmin and SPPDev Universal Polyglot Studio (`#polyglot`).
- `\SPP\Core\Polyglot\DSL\AbstractLanguage`: Pure-PHP in-process DSL tokenizer, Pratt AST parser, and sandboxed expression evaluator.
- `\SPP\SPPFS::searchContent($query, $opts)` & `replaceContent($query, $repl, $files)`: High-performance streaming grep and atomic multi-file replacement.
- `\SPPMod\SPPStorage\FilePropsManager`: Sovereign Manifest OS engine managing per-directory `__spp_file_props.yml` manifests, atomic writes, raw YAML validation, diff computation, manifest health scoring, and self-healing.
- `\SPP\Admin\Services\DnsZoneManager`: Authoritative DNS engine providing RFC 1035 parsing, immutable point-in-time revision history, rollback diff preview, 1-click atomic rollback, and automatic manifest synchronization.
- `\SPPMod\Parikshak\SPPTestRunner::discover($app)`: Framework-level test suite and method discovery.
- `\SPPMod\SPPStorage\AiArchitectureEngine::getProjectDiagnostics($app)`: Unified project health, AST linting, and 10 Golden Rules diagnostics.
- `window.SPPLocalVault` (`spplocalvault.js`): Framework client-side 0ms IndexedDB local vault and offline mutation queuing.
